blinding_guess.why: B has a dedicated test suite including a stdlib/single-file conformance test and refuses to start without a configured key, suggesting a spec-driven process.

notes: Both are stdlib-only single-file servers on 127.0.0.1:8080 with parameterized SQL and constant-time key comparison; bandit reported nothing for either. A requires auth on all routes except unknown paths (404 checked first); B requires auth on every request including reads. Probe P01 uses an explicit stdlib allowlist because the host Python is 3.9 (no sys.stdlib_module_names). P27 counts A's default 50-item page limit as a fail under the same expectation applied to B. A has no tests; B's 8 unittest tests pass.
